data.title: Glass slide
data.summary: Office aids · Plain microscope slide used for diascopy and for preparing smears and mounts.
data.body:
_Also called: Microscope slide, Diascope_

Plain microscope slide used for diascopy and for preparing smears and mounts.

## Uses / indications
- Diascopy (vitropression): purpura vs erythema; nevus depigmentosus vs nevus anemicus; apple-jelly nodules in lupus vulgaris, sarcoidosis
- Therapeutic diascopy: blanching the superficial part of a vascular malformation so laser reaches the deeper part
- Testing compressibility of vascular malformations
- Smears: imprint, tissue, crush, slit-skin smear for Gram, AFB, Giemsa/Wright stain; KOH (10-20%) mount
- Tzanck smear in calcinosis cutis (irregular deep blue basophilic granules)
- Elastosis perforans serpiginosa - elastic fibres in keratotic plug (KOH and stain)
- Transferring suction blister grafts from donor to recipient site
- Preparing hair mounts

## Method of use
1. Diascopy: press the slide firmly on the lesion and look for blanching or residual colour
